answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 177 identities means 177 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the haven pair is tracked in the basalt ledger, the ferrous audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward presupposes answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 58%. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
